highlights: close to local schools and amenities
open plan kitchen / dining room with french doors
summary: Occupying an enviable position within the ever-desirable Harrowgate Hill area, on the highly sought-after Alwyn Road, this exceptionally well-presented two-bedroom semi-detached home offers a perfect blend of character, space, and modern living.
description:
Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully styled throughout, the property delivers a warm and inviting atmosphere from the moment you step inside, making it an ideal purchase for a wide range of buyers. The location is equally impressive, with a host of local amenities, reputable schools, and shops all within easy reach. For those needing to commute, the property benefits from excellent transport connections, with swift access to the A1, ensuring convenient travel to surrounding towns and cities. Internally, the home showcases a contemporary yet homely interior, enhanced by generous proportions. High ceilings and a striking bay window to the front elevation flood the main living space with natural light, creating an airy and open feel that is both stylish and comfortable. The ground floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway leading into a beautifully presented lounge-perfect for relaxing evenings. To the rear, the property truly comes into its own with a generous open-plan kitchen and dining area, designed with modern living in mind. This sociable space is ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining guests, with French doors opening directly onto the rear garden, allowing for a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living during the warmer months. To the first floor, the sense of space continues with two generously sized bedrooms, each offering comfortable and versatile accommodation. A well-appointed family bathroom serves the property, while access to the loft via a pull-down ladder provides valuable additional storage. Externally, the property boasts excellent kerb appeal, being set back from the road behind a neat front forecourt. A gated side access leads through to the rear, where a substantial enclosed garden awaits. Thoughtfully arranged, the garden features paved seating areas perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining, alongside a well-maintained lawn and secure fenced boundaries-ideal for families, pets, or simply enjoying the outdoors in privacy. This superb home effortlessly combines style, comfort, and practicality in a highly regarded location. Early viewing is essential to fully appreciate the quality and lifestyle on offer.

ENTRANCE HALL The property is entered via a modern, contemporary entrance door into a welcoming hallway, setting the tone for the rest of the home. Featuring stylish wood flooring, the space offers staircase access to the first floor and provides internal access through to the lounge, creating a warm and inviting first impression.

LOUNGE The spacious lounge is beautifully presented and offers a warm and inviting living space, centred around a modern feature fire surround with inset and hearth housing a coal-effect fire, creating a stylish focal point to the room. Finished with attractive wood flooring, the space is further enhanced by a bay-style window, which not only adds character but also floods the room with natural light and enhances the sense of space. Additional features include a radiator for comfort and a useful built-in under-stairs storage cupboard, providing excellent practicality. The room flows seamlessly through to the kitchen/dining area, making it ideal for modern family living and entertaining.

OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / DINING ROOM The kitchen area is fitted with a contemporary range of modern wall and base units, complemented by laminate work surfaces incorporating an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is tiling to splashback and work surface areas, along with a built-in oven, hob, and overhead extractor fan. Additional benefits include plumbing for an automatic washing machine, space for a tall fridge freezer, and a wall-mounted combination gas central heating boiler. A useful breakfast bar provides a relaxed dining option, while a UPVC framed double-glazed window allows natural light to flow into the space. The kitchen is finished with attractive wood flooring. Flowing seamlessly into the dining area, the space continues with contrasting wood flooring and comfortably accommodates a dining table and chairs, creating a sociable and versatile setting. Further features include a radiator and UPVC framed double-glazed French doors, which open directly onto the rear garden, perfectly blending indoor and outdoor living.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

The first floor landing benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing for natural light to brighten the space and create an airy feel. The landing provides access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, completing the first-floor accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a most spacious double room, offering an excellent sense of space with ample room for a range of additional bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a charming feature character fire surround, adding warmth and focal interest, along with a radiator for comfort. A bay-style window enhances the room further, allowing for plenty of natural light and contributing to the bright and airy feel. Additional features include a useful built-in storage cupboard/robe space, and access to the loft via a pull-down ladder, providing valuable additional storage options or potential to convert.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is another well-proportioned double room, offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing for natural light, along with a radiator for comfort.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled bath with electric shower over, wash hand basin, and WC. The room benefits from tiled walls and a tiled floor, creating a clean and contemporary finish. Additional features include a chrome wall-mounted radiator and a UPVC framed double-glazed window, providing natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY To the front, the property is set back from the street behind a wall-enclosed forecourt garden with gated access, creating an attractive and private approach to the home. A side gate leads through to the rear garden. To the rear, there is a generously sized enclosed garden, offering an excellent outdoor space for both relaxation and entertaining. The garden features paved seating areas, ideal for outdoor dining, alongside a well-maintained lawn with flowerbeds planted with shrubs and flora, adding colour and interest. The garden is fully fenced for privacy, making it well suited to families and outdoor enjoyment.
